items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Yeah, an owl horn, or something like Old Man Barbarian played.

ctx.x: Uh, I was thinking about brass bands, but I wanted to ask you, um, those old brass bands, did they, did they, they must have sounded a little different than the brass bands they have now, didn't they? Did they have a lot of saxes in them then, like they have now?

No, they didn't have no sax, that, uh, they did, I mean, I don't remember them having no sax, but they, I know that they had a lot of those, I hear people call them pick horns. Yeah, an owl horn, or something like Old Man Barbarian played. That's right, yeah, they had a lot of them, and clarinet, they had more than one clarinet player. Did you ever play E-flat clarinet?
